# BookStack fixture provenance

The JSON files here are copied verbatim from official BookStack **v26.09.2** [dev/api examples](https://github.com/BookStackApp/BookStack/tree/v26.09.2/dev/api), retrieved on 2026-11-04. `pages-create.json`, `pages-update.json`, `pages-read.json`, `books-read.json`, `shelves-read.json`, `chapters-read.json`, `search-all.json` and `books-list.json` come from `dev/api/responses/`. `request-pages-create.json` and `request-pages-update.json` come from `dev/api/requests/`; only their local filenames add the request prefix. Their contents are unchanged. They are official documentation examples, **not captures from a service run by us**.

`TestOfficialDocumentationExamples` exercises the generated runtime dispatch with all eight official response examples. Other inline payloads are explicitly synthetic boundary variants, including large IDs, zero priority, empty tags/content, unsafe paths and malformed response shapes. Initial RED tests failed on a compiling stub before implementation.

Primary protocol sources inspected: [API docs](https://demo.bookstackapp.com/api/docs), [page controller](https://github.com/BookStackApp/BookStack/blob/v26.09.2/app/Entities/Controllers/PageApiController.php), [PageRepo](https://github.com/BookStackApp/BookStack/blob/v26.09.2/app/Entities/Repos/PageRepo.php), [book controller](https://github.com/BookStackApp/BookStack/blob/v26.09.2/app/Entities/Controllers/BookApiController.php), [shelf controller](https://github.com/BookStackApp/BookStack/blob/v26.09.2/app/Entities/Controllers/BookshelfApiController.php), [chapter controller](https://github.com/BookStackApp/BookStack/blob/v26.09.2/app/Entities/Controllers/ChapterApiController.php), [search controller](https://github.com/BookStackApp/BookStack/blob/v26.09.2/app/Search/SearchApiController.php), [release](https://github.com/BookStackApp/BookStack/releases/tag/v26.09.2) and [MIT license](https://github.com/BookStackApp/BookStack/blob/v26.09.2/LICENSE). No live BookStack deployment or account was used.
